study: fresh independent study, not pilot reproduction
scope: All tracked Python .py files in ten pinned framework snapshots; tests retained; actual # comments only; docstrings excluded.
normalization: Keep raw # tokens. For matching, remove the first # and leading whitespace on each token line, joining adjacent standalone comments with newline at identical indentation. Retain case in copy; regex flags ignore case.
